question: Which South Indian catalogue connections provide a finite stroke population and specimen targets for numerical tests?
outcome: Acquired the 2026 catalogue volumes and 48-route web snapshot. Counted 480 plain-stroke occurrences and 194 explicit stroke compounds; 142 have one stroke block and one other component. Found four literal cross-route identifier differences and independently confirmed missing stroke and base/variant discrepancies at 4.19C.
challenge: The API supplies separate context margins without joint specimen quantities or dates. Apparent full-book downloads were a brochure and a preview. Complete component naming excluded useful compounds in the initial calculation.
remedy: Preserve string identifiers and source namespaces, inspect actual PDF page counts, keep raw inputs local-only, retain the 115-form endpoint and declare a separate 194-form membership refinement, compare printed specimen tables and preserve digital discrepancies.
retry_when: An individually registered graffiti/Tamili specimen gains a readable numerical expression, measured vessel or deposit quantity, dated context, or photographic adjudication of a normalized compound.
